sentences.text:
On The 10 th Of May, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 44919 of 2019
 Lal Chand Chhajlani
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Petitioner through his counsel.
 Shri A.S. Baghel - Government Advocate for the State of
 Order
By way of the instant M.Cr.C. the petitioner has prayed for quashment of FIR dated 12.2.2018 in Crime No. 64 of 2018 at Goutam Nagar, P.S. Bhopal under Section 420, 467, 471/34 of IPC.
Learned Government Advocate informs that the aforesaid trial has been disposed of vide order dated 27.12.2024 by 11th Additional Sessions Judge, Bhopal.
In view of the statement so made by learned Government Advocate, nothing remains to be adjudicated.
This M.Cr.C. stands dismissed as having rendered infructuous.

(VIVEK AGARWAL)
